brand.tagline: Public domain classics, free and ad-free. Grab the popcorn.

seo.homeDescription: Watch thousands of public domain classic films, straight from the Internet Archive, with no ads.

catalog.moviesDescription: Public domain feature films, from the silent era to Hollywood classics.
catalog.shortsDescription: Chaplin, Keaton, Méliès, cartoons and other gems under 40 minutes.
catalog.decadesDescription: Travel through film history, one decade at a time.
catalog.portugueseDescription: Brazilian and Portuguese films from the silent era and early talkies: Humberto Mauro, José Medina, Leitão de Barros and other rarities.

decades.d1890: Cinema's first steps: the Lumière brothers and the first screenings.
decades.d1900: Méliès, camera tricks and the first stories told on film.
decades.d1910: Film learns to tell stories: Griffith, serials and the first stars.
decades.d1920: The height of silent film: Chaplin, Keaton, German expressionism and the Soviet avant-garde.
decades.d1930: Sound arrives: musicals, screwball comedies and the classic monsters.
decades.d1940: Film noir, war pictures and big studio productions.
decades.d1950: Science fiction, B horror and drive-in cinema.
decades.d1960: New winds: independent film, horror and experimentation.
decades.d1970: Independent productions and rarities that fell into the public domain.
